tools.name: notifications_recent
tools.title: Recent notifications
tools.description: The latest notifications the user has had on this desktop, newest first: app, summary, body and time (ISO 8601), and whether Do Not Disturb is on (dnd). Use it when the user asks what they missed, or what a notification said.

tools.name: notifications_send
tools.title: Send a notification
tools.description: Show the user a notification on this desktop, from Claude: a reminder or a result they should see when they look up ("tell me when the build is done"). It stays in the notification history; the same text again replaces it instead of adding another. Do Not Disturb hides the popup but not the row.

body.description: The text under it, a sentence or two

tools.name: notifications_dnd
tools.title: Do Not Disturb
tools.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off: while it's on, notifications don't pop up or chime, and they still go into the history (notifications_recent shows whether it's on). Turning it on also hides the popups on screen now.
